description:
Porn had stopped turning Hyuk on like it used to. Everything was so repetitive, boring, and uninspired…because nothing compared to Park Ara. After catching her masturbating in the staircase of their college prep academy, Hyuk made it his mission to get close to her, despite the fact that his girlfriend, Minjung, is the hottest, most popular girl their academy. But she will hardly ever have sex with Hyuk, giving him one more reason to be drawn to Ara. However, there’s something else even more enticing about her; she listens to his every command, like his very own obedient little pet. Sit, stay, get on all fours…Hyuk teaches Ara how exciting sex can be, doggy style!
